description: Look up any Norwegian company or organisation in the official registers of the Brønnøysund Register Centre (Brønnøysundregistrene). Search companies by name, organisation form, municipality, industry, size, registration date and status; get a full record from an organisation number; see who runs a company, who sits on its board and who audits it; map its corporate group; read the key figures of its annual accounts and download the filed accounts as PDFs; look up sites and branches and the Register of Non-Profit Organisations; and follow the feeds of new, changed and deleted companies, with triggers for new registrations and for changes to companies you watch. Norwegian codes come back with English names beside them. Every action reads: nothing here changes the registers. No account or API key required.
